metrics.name: linkedInAds.impressions
metrics.label: Impressions
metrics.description: Number of times your ad was shown (or messages sent for Sponsored Messaging).

metrics.name: linkedInAds.clicks
metrics.label: Clicks
metrics.description: Chargeable clicks on your LinkedIn ads during the reporting period.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.costInLocalCurrency
metrics.label: Spend
metrics.description: Total amount spent in your account currency during the reporting period.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.spend
metrics.label: Spend
metrics.description: Total amount spent in your account currency during the reporting period.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.costInUsd
metrics.label: Cost (USD)
metrics.description: Total amount spent in USD during the reporting period.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.costPerQualifiedLead
metrics.label: Cost per qualified lead
metrics.description: Average spend per qualified lead: spend ÷ qualified leads.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.conversions
metrics.label: Website conversions
metrics.description: Number of website conversion events attributed to your ads.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.externalWebsiteConversions
metrics.label: Website conversions
metrics.description: Number of website conversion events attributed to your ads.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.externalWebsitePostClickConversions

metrics.name: linkedInAds.externalWebsitePostViewConversions
metrics.label: Post-view conversions
metrics.description: Website conversions attributed to viewing your ads without clicking.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.conversionValueInLocalCurrency
metrics.label: Conversion value
metrics.description: Total revenue attributed to conversion events in your account currency.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.landingPageClicks
metrics.label: Landing page clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks that directed users to your landing page.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.companyPageClicks
metrics.label: Company page clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks to your LinkedIn company page from your ads.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.likes
metrics.label: Likes
metrics.description: Number of likes on your sponsored content.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.shares
metrics.label: Shares
metrics.description: Number of times your sponsored content was shared.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.comments
metrics.label: Comments
metrics.description: Number of comments on your sponsored content.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.commentLikes
metrics.label: Comment likes
metrics.description: Number of likes on comments on your sponsored content.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.reactions
metrics.label: Reactions
metrics.description: Number of reactions (likes, loves, etc.) on your sponsored content.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.follows
metrics.label: Follows
metrics.description: Number of new LinkedIn page followers gained from your ads.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.totalEngagements
metrics.label: Total engagements
metrics.description: Total engagement actions on your ads (clicks, reactions, shares, comments, etc.).

metrics.name: linkedInAds.otherEngagements
metrics.label: Other engagements
metrics.description: Other engagement actions on your sponsored content not counted separately.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.oneClickLeads
metrics.label: Lead Gen Form submissions
metrics.description: Number of leads captured via LinkedIn's one-click Lead Gen Forms.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.oneClickLeadFormOpens
metrics.label: Lead Gen Form opens
metrics.description: Number of times your Lead Gen Form was opened.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.qualifiedLeads
metrics.label: Qualified leads
metrics.description: Number of leads that matched your qualification criteria.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.validWorkEmailLeads
metrics.label: Valid work email leads
metrics.description: Number of leads with a verified work email address.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.talentLeads
metrics.label: Talent leads
metrics.description: Number of talent leads captured from LinkedIn Talent Insights ads.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.leadGenerationMailContactInfoShares
metrics.label: InMail contact info shares
metrics.description: Number of times contact info was shared via a Sponsored InMail Lead Gen form.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.leadGenerationMailInterestedClicks
metrics.label: InMail interested clicks
metrics.description: Number of interested clicks on Sponsored InMail Lead Gen messages.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.opens
metrics.label: Opens
metrics.description: Number of times your Sponsored InMail or message ads were opened.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.sends
metrics.label: Sends
metrics.description: Number of Sponsored InMail or message ads sent.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.actionClicks
metrics.label: Action clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks on the call-to-action button in your Sponsored InMail.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.adUnitClicks
metrics.label: Ad unit clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks on the display ad unit within a Sponsored InMail.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.textUrlClicks
metrics.label: Text URL clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks on text links in your Sponsored InMail.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.jobApplications
metrics.label: Job applications
metrics.description: Number of job applications attributed to your ads.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.postClickJobApplications
metrics.label: Job applications (post-click)
metrics.description: Job applications attributed to clicks on your ads.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.postViewJobApplications
metrics.label: Job applications (post-view)

metrics.name: linkedInAds.jobApplyClicks
metrics.label: Job apply clicks

metrics.name: linkedInAds.postClickJobApplyClicks
metrics.label: Job apply clicks (post-click)
metrics.description: Apply button clicks attributed to clicks on your ads.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.postViewJobApplyClicks
metrics.label: Job apply clicks (post-view)
metrics.description: Apply button clicks attributed to viewing your ads without clicking.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.registrations
metrics.label: Event registrations
metrics.description: Number of event registrations attributed to your ads.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.postClickRegistrations
metrics.label: Event registrations (post-click)
metrics.description: Event registrations attributed to clicks on your ads.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.postViewRegistrations
metrics.label: Event registrations (post-view)
metrics.description: Event registrations attributed to viewing your ads without clicking.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.videoViews
metrics.label: Video views
metrics.description: Number of times your video ad was viewed.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.videoStarts
metrics.label: Video starts
metrics.description: Number of times your video ad started playing.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.videoCompletions
metrics.label: Video completions
metrics.description: Number of times your video was watched to at least 97% completion.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.videoFirstQuartileCompletions
metrics.label: Video views 25%
metrics.description: Number of times your video was watched to at least 25% completion.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.videoMidpointCompletions
metrics.label: Video views 50%
metrics.description: Number of times your video was watched to at least 50% completion.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.videoThirdQuartileCompletions
metrics.label: Video views 75%
metrics.description: Number of times your video was watched to at least 75% completion.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.videoWatchTime
metrics.label: Video watch time
metrics.description: Total time users spent watching your video ads.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.fullScreenPlays
metrics.label: Full screen plays
metrics.description: Number of times users expanded your video ad to full screen.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.documentCompletions
metrics.label: Document completions
metrics.description: Number of times your Document Ad was scrolled to the final page.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.documentFirstQuartileCompletions
metrics.label: Document viewed 25%
metrics.description: Number of times your Document Ad was scrolled to at least 25% of pages.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.documentMidpointCompletions
metrics.label: Document viewed 50%
metrics.description: Number of times your Document Ad was scrolled to at least 50% of pages.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.documentThirdQuartileCompletions
metrics.label: Document viewed 75%
metrics.description: Number of times your Document Ad was scrolled to at least 75% of pages.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.downloadClicks
metrics.label: Download clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks on the download icon in your Document Ad.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.subscriptionClicks
metrics.label: Subscription clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks on the subscription button in your ads.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.headlineClicks
metrics.label: Headline clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks on the headline of your Sponsored Content ads.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.headlineImpressions
metrics.label: Headline impressions
metrics.description: Number of times the headline of your Sponsored Content was displayed.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.approximateMemberReach
metrics.label: Approximate member reach
metrics.description: Estimated number of unique LinkedIn members who saw your ads.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.averageDwellTime
metrics.label: Average dwell time
metrics.description: Average time users spent with your ad in view.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.audiencePenetration
metrics.label: Audience penetration
metrics.description: Proportion of your target audience that was reached by your ads: unique members reached ÷ total audience size.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.cardClicks
metrics.label: Card clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks on the cards within your Carousel Ad.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.cardImpressions
metrics.label: Card impressions
metrics.description: Number of times the cards within your Carousel Ad were displayed.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.viralImpressions
metrics.label: Viral impressions
metrics.description: Number of times your ad was shown through organic sharing (likes, shares, follows) by members who engaged with it.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.viralClicks
metrics.label: Viral clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks on your ad that originated from organic viral distribution.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.viralLikes
metrics.label: Viral likes
metrics.description: Number of likes on your ad that originated from organic viral distribution.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.viralShares
metrics.label: Viral shares
metrics.description: Number of times your ad was shared through organic viral distribution.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.viralComments
metrics.label: Viral comments
metrics.description: Number of comments on your ad that originated from organic viral distribution.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.viralLandingPageClicks
metrics.label: Viral landing page clicks
metrics.description: Number of landing page clicks from viral distribution of your ad.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.viralTotalEngagements
metrics.label: Viral total engagements
metrics.description: Total engagement actions from viral distribution of your ad (clicks, likes, shares, comments, etc.).

metrics.name: linkedInAds.viralExternalWebsiteConversions
metrics.label: Viral website conversions
metrics.description: Website conversions attributed to viral (organic) distribution of your ad.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.viralExternalWebsitePostClickConversions
metrics.label: Viral post-click conversions
metrics.description: Website conversions from clicks on a viral (organically shared) version of your ad.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.viralExternalWebsitePostViewConversions
metrics.label: Viral post-view conversions
metrics.description: Website conversions from views of a viral (organically shared) version of your ad without clicking.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.viralVideoViews
metrics.label: Viral video views
metrics.description: Number of times your video was viewed through organic viral distribution.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.viralVideoStarts
metrics.label: Viral video starts
metrics.description: Number of times your video started playing through organic viral distribution.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.viralVideoCompletions
metrics.label: Viral video completions
metrics.description: Number of times your video was watched to at least 97% completion through organic viral distribution.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.viralOneClickLeads
metrics.label: Viral Lead Gen Form submissions
metrics.description: Leads captured via Lead Gen Forms through viral (organic) distribution of your ad.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.viralCardClicks
metrics.label: Viral card clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks on carousel cards from viral (organic) distribution of your ad.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.viralCardImpressions
metrics.label: Viral card impressions
metrics.description: Number of times carousel cards were displayed through viral (organic) distribution of your ad.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.eventViews
metrics.label: Event views
metrics.description: Number of times your LinkedIn Event Ad was viewed.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.eventViewsOver15Seconds
metrics.label: Event views 15s+
metrics.description: Number of times your Event Ad was viewed for more than 15 seconds.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.eventViewsOver30Seconds
metrics.label: Event views 30s+
metrics.description: Number of times your Event Ad was viewed for more than 30 seconds.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.eventViewsOver2Minutes
metrics.label: Event views 2min+
metrics.description: Number of times your Event Ad was viewed for more than 2 minutes.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.revenueAttributionMetrics
metrics.label: Revenue attribution
metrics.description: Total revenue attributed to your ads via LinkedIn's revenue attribution reporting.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.ctr
metrics.label: CTR
metrics.description: Click-through rate: clicks divided by impressions, shown as a percentage.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.cpm
metrics.label: CPM
metrics.description: Average cost per 1,000 impressions in your account currency.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.cpc
metrics.label: CPC
metrics.description: Average cost per click: spend divided by clicks.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.costPerConversion
metrics.label: Cost per conversion
metrics.description: Average spend for each conversion: spend divided by the number of conversion events.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.conversionRate
metrics.label: Conversion rate
metrics.description: Percentage of clicks that resulted in a website conversion: conversions ÷ clicks.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.conversionRateByImpressions
metrics.label: Conversion rate (by impressions)
metrics.description: Percentage of impressions that resulted in a website conversion: conversions ÷ impressions.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.engagementRate
metrics.label: Engagement rate
metrics.description: Percentage of impressions that resulted in an engagement action: total engagements ÷ impressions.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.costPerLead
metrics.label: Cost per lead
metrics.description: Average spend for each lead: spend divided by the number of lead events.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.leadRate
metrics.label: Lead rate
metrics.description: Percentage of impressions that resulted in a Lead Gen Form submission: leads ÷ impressions.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.roas
metrics.label: ROAS
metrics.description: Return on ad spend for this event: attributed revenue or value divided by spend.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.landingPageCtr
metrics.label: Landing page CTR
metrics.description: Percentage of impressions that resulted in a click to your landing page: landing page clicks ÷ impressions.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.videoViewRate
metrics.label: Video view rate
metrics.description: Percentage of impressions that resulted in a video view: video views ÷ impressions.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.videoCompletionRate
metrics.label: Video completion rate
metrics.description: Percentage of video starts that were watched to at least 97% completion: video completions ÷ video starts.

metrics.name: linkedInAds.qualifiedLeadRate
metrics.label: Qualified lead rate
metrics.description: Percentage of Lead Gen Form submissions that were qualified leads: qualified leads ÷ total leads.
metrics.formula: Qualified leads ÷ Lead Gen Form submissions
